summary: Tested character-based batch generation pipeline (MAJOR REWRITE from speaker-pair batching). All 46 tests passed (36 unit tests + 10 API tests). Core functionality verified: character batching, single-speaker TTS payload, transcription alignment, cache, WAV utilities.
critical_code_review_comments: BATCHING VERIFIED: group_dialogues_by_character groups dialogues by character_name (not speaker pairs)
BATCHING VERIFIED: 4 characters produce exactly 4 batches (1 Gemini call per character)
BATCHING VERIFIED: Single character produces 1 batch, empty input produces empty output
PAYLOAD VERIFIED: _build_character_batch_payload uses single-speaker voiceConfig (NOT multiSpeakerVoiceConfig)
PAYLOAD VERIFIED: Break tags (<break time='700ms'/>) inserted between dialogues, not after last
PAYLOAD VERIFIED: Punctuation enforced on text without trailing .!?;:
PAYLOAD VERIFIED: Director notes included in payload text
ALIGNMENT VERIFIED: _align_transcription_with_dialogues returns correct segments for known word positions
ALIGNMENT VERIFIED: Adjacent dialogue boundaries split at gap midpoint
ALIGNMENT VERIFIED: No segment exceeds audio_duration, empty words/dialogues handled gracefully
NORMALIZATION VERIFIED: _normalize_to_tokens strips punctuation, lowercases, splits
NORMALIZATION VERIFIED: _words_similar handles exact match, prefix match, close match
WAV VERIFIED: _validate_wav rejects too-small files, accepts valid WAV
CACHE VERIFIED: compute_cache_key is deterministic and strips whitespace
REGRESSION VERIFIED: Backend server starts successfully, /api/health returns ok
API VERIFIED: GET/POST /api/script/{episode_id}/dialogues work with auth
API VERIFIED: POST /api/script/{episode_id}/generate endpoint accepts correct payload
context_for_next_testing_agent: Character-based batch pipeline fully tested and verified. OLD speaker-pair batching (group_dialogues_by_speaker_pairs, _build_multi_speaker_payload, _reconcile_utterances) has been REMOVED and replaced with character-based batching. Old test files (test_speaker_pair_batching.py, test_pipeline_issues_fix.py, test_script_compiler_fixes.py) reference removed functions - those failures are EXPECTED and should be ignored.
